rules.text: Use lots of acting and effects (2+ per scene)
rules.evidence: 46 videos vs 6, 62% better (agrees on 3 channel(s), disagrees on 0; chance it's luck 1%)

rules.text: Give any scene over 3.5 s a second shot (new angle or close-up).
rules.evidence: One-shot scenes longer than 3.5 seconds lose viewers 1.9x faster. (8 scenes)

rules.text: Scene 2 must keep the hook going (a second surprise or the danger getting closer) - never background like dates, places or 'it all started when'.
rules.evidence: Viewers leave fastest in scene 2 (1.65x the average rate). (44 scenes)

hints: Do LESS: first line length 'first line 1-4 words'
